description: Acterys Visual Planning is a next-gen Power BI planning visual designed to revolutionize how organizations manage planning and forecasting. With an intuitive drag-and-drop planning interface in Power BI, users can update, compare, and lock values directly inside interactive bar, column, area, or line charts. Built for speed and usability, this custom Power BI visual for planning allows for real-time scenario management, write-back functionality, and seamless variance tracking. Whether you're modeling revenue scenarios or adjusting forecasts, Acterys Visual Planning brings dynamic planning right to your Power BI dashboard—no spreadsheets or complex setups required. Part of Acterys' integrated suite, this visual is perfect for organizations looking to enable interactive planning and real-time forecasting in Power BI. Key Features: Write-Back, Planning, and Forecasting: Edit data within charts and instantly visualize changes across planning scenarios. Compare and manage forecasting assumptions with ease. Flexible Data Entry: Input as absolute values or percentages of totals to fit both detailed and high-level plans. Data Point Locking & Redistribution: Lock key values and redistribute others automatically for accuracy and balance. Totals & Variance Display: See totals and variance analysis in Power BI at a glance for performance-focused insights. Category Drill-Down: Dive deeper…
